prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a sideswipe while changing lanes claim. Injury: whiplash. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1244; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following report of sideswipe during lane change. Insured reports other vehicle moved into their lane without signaling. Both drivers remained on scene. Police report requested. No visible damage to insured's rear quarter panel beyond scuffing; photos uploaded to file.

Entry 2: Spoke with insured. Insured states they checked mirrors and believed the lane was clear. Recorded statement taken. Claimant's vehicle has moderate damage to driver-side door and fender. Estimate requested from preferred shop.

Entry 3: Claimant reports neck pain and stiffness and has been evaluated at urgent care. Diagnosis listed as whiplash-type cervical strain. Claimant has retained counsel; all further contact to go through attorney's office. Letter of representation received and logged.

Entry 4: Liability under review. Witness statement obtained from driver in adjacent lane who confirms the claimant's vehicle drifted left before contact. Preliminary fault assessment leans toward shared responsibility pending review of the police report and vehicle damage patterns. Medical records requested through counsel.

Entry 5: Attorney's office submitted treatment summary and demand package for bodily injury. Demand under review by supervisor. Reserves adjusted to reflect injury component. Next step: medical records review and scheduled call with counsel to discuss liability position.
